Palladium-Catalyzed TripleC yclization of 2,7-Alkadiynylic
Carbonates with Allenes Bearing aC arbonN ucleophile
Xin Huang,[a] Wangteng Wu,[a] Chunling Fu,[a] YihuaY u,[b] and ShengmingM a*[a]
Dedicatedt o Dr.N egishi on the occasion of his 80th birthday
Abstract: Palladium-catalyzed tandemr eactions of 2,7-
alkadiynylic carbonates with allenesb earinga carbon nu-
cleophile such as malonate and bis(phenylsulfonyl)me-
thane for the efficient syntheses of fused tricycles, such as
3,5,6,7-tetrahydro-1H-indeno[5,6-c]furan, 1,2,3,5,6,7-hexa-
hydrocyclopenta[f]isoindole, and 1,2,3,5,6,7-hexahydro-s-
indacene derivatives, have been reported. The reaction
forms two five-membered rings and one benzene ring
fusing them in the middle.
Polycycles are important structural motifs existingi n
nature with significant pharmacological and biologi-
cal activities[1] and thus have attracted much atten-
tion from the chemical community.[2] However,e ffi-
ciency is always the goal. In our previous work, an
efficient approacht os ubstituted 1,5,7,8,9-pentahy-
drocyclopenta-[h]-2-benzopyran-3-one derivatives by
ap alladium-catalyzed tandemr eaction of 2,7-alka-
diynylicc arbonates[3] with 2,3-allenoica cids has
been reported (Scheme 1, Eq. (1)).[4] We envisioned
that similar tandemr eactions may occur if the 2,3-
allenoica cids are replaced with allenes bearing
ac arbon-centered nucleophile. However,a totally
different tricyclics keleton, that is, 3,5,6,7-tetrahydro-
1H-indeno[5,6-c]furan, 1,2,3,5,6,7-hexahydrocyclopen-
ta[f]isoindole, or 1,2,3,5,6,7-hexahydro-s-indacene de-
rivatives, was constructed( Scheme 1, Eq. (2)). Herein, we wish
to report such recent observations.
Initially,w ec onductedt he reaction of 2,7-alkadiynylic car-
bonate( 1a )( 0.3 mmol) andd imethyl 2-(buta-2,3-dien-1-yl)mal-
onate (4a )( 1.2 equiv) under the catalysis of [Pd(PPh3)4]
(5 mol %) and K3PO4 (3.0 equiv) at 70 8Cf or 12 hi nD MSO.U n-
expectedly,w ed id not observe the predictedt ricyclic product
3a a,i nstead, an ew tricyclic 4-isopropyl-6,6-dimethoxycarbon-
yl-8-phenyl-3,5,6,7-tetrahydro-1H-indeno[5,6-c]furan (5a a)w as
identified in 67 %N MR yield and 53 %i solated yield as deter-
minedb yt he 1Ha nd 13CN MR spectroscopica nalysis (Table 1,
entry 3). Encouraged by this exciting observation, the influence
of the critical reaction parameters was investigated and repre-
sentativer esults are summarized in Table 1.
By changingt he molar ratio of 1a /4a ,a ll the reactions af-
forded 5a a in lower yields of 59–65% (Table 1, entries 1–2 and
4,). After screening as eries of solvents, it was found that
DMSO was still the best one. We could not observe any cyclic
product 5a a when using 1,4-dioxane or THF as the solvent
(entries 5a nd 6). In contrast, the reactions in CH3CN or DMF
led to poorer resultst han that in DMSO (entries 7a nd 8). The
effect of base was also investigated with K2CO3 being slightly
bettert han K3PO4 and 5a a could be formed in the highest
yield of 69 %( entries 9a nd 10). In addition, running the reac-
tion at 60 or 80 8Cf ailed to improvet he yield of 5a a (entries 11
and 12). Therefore, [Pd(PPh3)4]( 5m ol %), 4a (1.2 equiv), and
K2CO3 (3.0 equiv) in DMSO at 70 8Cw eree stablished as the
standardr eactionc onditions for further study.
With the optimizedc onditions in hand, we first examined
the reactivity of various oxygen-tethered 2,7-alkadiynylic carbo-
nates 1 with dimethyl 2-(buta-2,3-dien-1-yl)malonate (4a )o r
1,1-bis(phenylsulfonyl)penta-3,4-diene (4b )a ffording different
3,5,6,7-tetrahydro-1H-indeno[5,6-c]furan derivatives (Table 2,
entries1 –16). The reactiono ft ertiary 2,7-diynic carbonates

this methodc ould be extended to 2-thien-
yl- or cyclohexenyl-substituted 2,7-alka-

is also applicable to nitrogen- or carbon-
tethered 2,7-alkadiynylic carbonates to
form 1,2,3,5,6,7-hexahydrocyclopenta[f]i-
soindole derivatives (5o a, 5p a)a nd

5q a in moderate yields (entries 17–19). We
also investigated the reaction of the reac-
tion of 1a with 4a on a1 gs cale (entry 2).
The structure of this tricyclic product
was unambiguously established by the X-
ray diffraction analysiso fp roduct 5i a
(Figure 1).[5]
When the optically active 2,7-alkadiynylic carbonates( R)-1r
and (R)-1s containing ac entral chirality were subjected to the
standard reactionc onditions, (R)-5r a and (R)-5s a were ob-
tained in 70 and 63 %y ields, respectively,w ithout any loss of
enantiomeric purity (Scheme 2).
Interestingly,t he substrate 1t ,w hich has two symmetric
yne-propargylic carbonate units, could also reactw ith 4a af-
fording the corresponding product 5t a in 46 %y ield. Six rings
were constructed in just one operation [Eq. (3)].

4a as an example:o xidative addition of 1a with Pd0 would
afford the allenylpalladium intermediate IN-1,[6] which under-
goes intramolecular insertion of the triple bond to generate
the alkenylpalladium species IN-
2.[3] The species IN-2 undergoes
highly regioselective intermo-
lecular carbopalladationo ft he
allene moiety in 4a to generate
allylpalladium intermediate anti-
IN-3 highly stereoselectively,[7]
insteado ff orming the key inter-
mediate IN-6 by the direct
attack of the carbon nucleo-
phile leadingt he formation of
3a a as reported in ref. [4] prob-
ably due to the sterice ffect
and/or the weaker nucleophilici-
ty of the in situ generated
anionic carbon center.T hen intramolecular nucleo-
philic allylation forms allene–diene intermediate IN-4
and regenerates the catalytically active Pd0.A fter 6e-
electrocyclization and aromatization,[8] the final prod-
uct 5a a was delivered. There is another alternative
pathway to IN-5.I ntramolecular carbopalladation of
allene would form an ew allylpalladium intermediate
IN-7.D ue to the presence of the conjugatedd iene,
IN-7 would be transformed to IN-8 with the allylpal-
ladium unit attacked by the nucleophile to form the final five-
membered ring in IN-5.
In conclusion, we have developed an efficient methodology
for the syntheses of fused tricy-
cles, such as 3,5,6,7-tetrahydro-
1H-indeno[5,6-c]furan, 1,2,3,5,
6,7-hexahydrocyclopenta[f]isoin-
dole, and 1,2,3,5,6,7-hexahydro-
s-indacene derivatives, from 2,7-
alkadiynylic carbonates with al-
lenes bearing ac arbon nucleo-
phile. Four new carbon–carbon
bonds are formed within one
operation from readily available
starting materials.[9] No racemi-
zation occurred to the central
chirality in the starting materials.
Due to the importanceo ft his
attractive tricyclics keleton,[10]
the reactionw ill be potentially
useful in organic synthesis and
medical chemistry.F urther stud-
ies on expanding the scope of
the reactiona nd synthetic appli-
cations are being pursued in our
laboratory.
